AggTrade.description:
Binance aggregated trade.

Uses AggTradeMetadata which fixes stream=AGG_TRADE and schema_version via Literal.
quantity MUST be > 0.

normal_quantity.description: USD-M normal order quantity (nq), absent when unavailable
normal_quantity.title: Normal Quantity

quantity.description: Total quantity of the aggregate trade (> 0)
quantity.title: Quantity

AggTrade.title: AggTrade

AggTradeMetadata.description: Metadata for AggTrade events. stream and schema_version are required constants.
AggTradeMetadata.title: AggTradeMetadata

BookTicker.description:
Binance book ticker — best bid and ask with quantities.

Uses BookTickerMetadata which fixes stream=BOOK_TICKER and schema_version via Literal.
Accepts crossed books (best_bid_price >= best_ask_price).
BookTicker.title: BookTicker

BookTickerMetadata.description: Metadata for BookTicker events. stream and schema_version are required constants.
BookTickerMetadata.title: BookTickerMetadata

ConsumerGapNotice.description: Informs the consumer that a gap has been detected in their stream.
ConsumerGapNotice.title: ConsumerGapNotice

DepthUpdate.description:
Binance order book depth update.

Uses DepthUpdateMetadata which fixes stream=DIFF_DEPTH and schema_version via Literal.
Both are required in serialized form.
DepthUpdate.title: DepthUpdate

DepthUpdateMetadata.description: Metadata for DepthUpdate events. stream and schema_version are required constants.
DepthUpdateMetadata.title: DepthUpdateMetadata

Liquidation.description: USD-M forceOrder sample; not a complete liquidation list.
Liquidation.title: Liquidation

MarkPrice.description: USD-M mark-price update; T is next funding time, not transaction time.
MarkPrice.title: MarkPrice

PriceLevel.description:
A single price level in the order book.

quantity represents the absolute quantity at this price level after the update.
quantity == "0" means this price level should be removed.
PriceLevel.title: PriceLevel

QualityFlag.description:
Quality flags describe data facts — what is observed about the data.

These are distinct from ReasonCode which explains Health state judgments.
QualityFlag.title: QualityFlag

ReasonCode.description: Reason codes explain Health state judgments — why a state was chosen.
ReasonCode.title: ReasonCode

StreamStatus.description: Reports the lifecycle state of a consumer subscription stream.
StreamStatus.title: StreamStatus

SubscriptionAccepted.description: Confirms a subscription was accepted by the Gateway.
SubscriptionAccepted.title: SubscriptionAccepted

description:
Wraps a single event for the contiguous event stream.

Exactly one payload field must be set.
